source_caption:
Tom Cruise insisted on using a massive real LED sky projection for the cockpit scenes in Oblivion, rather than green screens. Director Joseph Kosinski used high-resolution images projected around the set, giving the actors real light and reflections—making the visuals feel more immersive and realistic.

Oblivion (2013), directed by Joseph Kosinski, starring Tom Cruise, Olga Kurylenko, Andrea Riseborough. A sleek and atmospheric sci-fi thriller that follows a lone technician on a devastated Earth, uncovering truths that challenge his identity and reality.

#Oblivion #TomCruise #SciFiMovie #JosephKosinski #ModernCinema

source_details.title: Oblivion
source_details.synopsis: Oblivion is a 2013 American epic post-apocalyptic science fiction action film produced and directed by Joseph Kosinski from a screenplay by Karl Gajdusek and Michael deBruyn, starring Tom Cruise in the main role alongside Morgan Freeman, Olga Kurylenko, Andrea Riseborough, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, and Melissa Leo in supporting roles. Based on Kosinski's unpublished Radical Comics graphic novel of the same name, the film pays homage to 1970s sci-fi, and is a "love story" set in 2077 on a post-apocalyptic Earth desolated by an alien war.
